'''JPOTSD Booster Draft''' is a booster draft format in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015), played with the Jabba's Palace Official Tournament Sealed Deck ([[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]).<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' one Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck per player; the boosters are drafted, the premium cards are not
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015; events not recorded
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Each player needs one Jabba's Palace Official Tournament Sealed Deck. The format uses the guide's [[Booster Draft]] rules. The premium packs are opened as if the format were sealed, and only the booster packs are drafted.<ref name="afg" />

Special rule: any character of ability 1 with a printed deploy number of 3 or more is considered, for all purposes, to be ability 2. The rule applies to Dark Side and Light Side characters.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
The ability rule comes from [[Decipher]]. On 10 November 2000 Decipher issued it as a "New Official Rule for Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Environment", to balance play in Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck tournaments only. Tournament directors were to recognize it from the weekend of 10 November 2000.<ref name="dec-jpsd">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/jabbaspalace.asp New Official Rule for Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck Environment], Decipher (10 November 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020220232819/http://tournaments.decipher.com/jabbaspalace.asp Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee guide carries the same rule into its draft version of the product.<ref name="afg" /> No event in this format is recorded on this wiki.
